chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: LEQ — Long Essay Question (6 points) — Q3 Set 2: Enlightenment and Reform Movements
chunks.content: AP World History LEQ, 6 points, standardized rubric. A Thesis/Claim [1]. B Contextualization [1]. C Evidence [0–2]: two specific pieces (1), used to support the argument (1). D Analysis and Reasoning [0–2]: reasoning process (causation/CCOT) (1), complex understanding (1). Q3 Set 2 prompt: the Enlightenment and reform movements. Common failure: reasoning process present without complexity; evidence not tied to the argument.

chunks.title: LEQ Q3 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 3B, 4/6
chunks.content: Q3 (Set 2) scored 4/6 (Thesis 1, Context 1, Evidence 2, Analysis 0). Earned the thesis, contextualization, and both Evidence points but lost BOTH Analysis points (no reasoning process framing and no complexity). Illustrates a well-built essay that never earns the analysis row.

chunks.content: Q3 (Set 2) scored 2/6 (Thesis 1, Context 0, Evidence 1, Analysis 0). Earned the thesis and one Evidence point. Lost contextualization, the second Evidence point, and both Analysis points. Illustrates a low essay with a claim and a little evidence.
